# Test evidence

<!-- GENERATED by tools/evidence/collect.py --site configurator/data --docs docs/assurance/evidence.md: do not
edit; the data is configurator/data/evidence/<version>.json (schema catalog/schemas/evidence.schema.json). -->

What CI tested for each kb-core release, and what it found: the test protocol (every check, its tool and its
gate) and the results, read from the CI artifacts and release assets of the release tag alone. The
[configurator](../app/index.html) shows the same data, with charts, for the kb-core version you select.

After each release, `gh run download <run of the tag> -D artifacts`, `gh run view <run> --json
databaseId,url,conclusion,headSha,headBranch,createdAt,jobs > artifacts/run.json` and `gh release download <tag> -D
assets` feed `tools/evidence/collect.py --artifacts artifacts --assets assets --version <version> -o
configurator/data/evidence/<version>.json`; then `--site configurator/data --docs docs/assurance/evidence.md` rewrites
this page and the page's data, and CI checks both are current.

These are the results of the checks; they are not a safety claim ([assurance
level](../adr/ADR-0011-assurance-level-high.md)).

## 0.1.0-rc.1

Tag `v0.1.0-rc.1` at `b0ddc2f19612`, CI run
[44871665969](https://github.com/kokeb-labs/kb-core/actions/runs/44871665969) (success, 2026-11-21). **Every check
passed.**

### MISRA C++:2023

Level high, passed: 179 guidelines (50 advisory, 5 mandatory, 124 required); 148 clean, 6 with findings, 3 deviated.
Findings: 33 (advisory guidelines Rule 0.0.2, Rule 0.2.3, Rule 0.2.4, Rule 4.1.2, Rule 10.1.1, Rule 15.1.4), 29 under a
deviation, 862 for review. Deviation records: DEV-KBC-001, DEV-KBC-002, DEV-KBC-003, DEV-KBC-004, MD-CPP-001,
MD-CPP-002, MD-CPP-003, MD-CPP-004, MD-CPP-005, MD-CPP-006, MD-CPP-007, MD-CPP-008, MD-CPP-009
([deviations](../deviations.md)).

| Configuration | Translation units | Source files | Complete |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| host | 272 | 65 | yes |
| cortex-m | 265 | 65 | yes |

### Fuzzing and sanitizers

`fuzz_handlers_channel`, `fuzz_utils_bytes`, `fuzz_utils_crc`, `fuzz_utils_journal`, `fuzz_utils_ring`), 120 s each (720
s planned; the step ran 727 s): pass. Sanitizers (AddressSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer) over the unit tests:
pass.
